text:
My dear, peace
so unspeakably boring.

There are no telepathies, no ghosts,
Net flying saucers.
They cannot exist.
Peace rules cast iron laws.
These laws are not violated.
They simply cannot be broken.

I'm not hoping for flying saucers.
That would be too interesting.
But what about the Bermuda Triangle?

You are not going to contradict ...
- Yes, her.
There is no Bermuda Triangle.
There is a triangle ABC,

which equals
Triangle - Prime, B Prime, C Prime.
It's all so tiring, so tiring.
In the Middle Ages, life was interesting.

Every home had its own goblin,
God was in every church.

People were young.
Now every fourth person is old.
This is boring, my angel. It's so boring.

But you said that zone is a product
super civilizations -

Which is probably also boring,
Also with laws and triangles,

But no goblins
And, of course, without God.

Because if there is God,
It will be a triangle.
Then I just don't know her.
This is for me. Goodbye, dear friend.

This lovely lady agreed
come with us to the zone.
She is so brave. My name is -
Excuse me, what's your name?
Are you really a stalker?
I'll explain it all later.
Getting lost.
Idiot.
So you drank?

just drank it
Like half of humanity.

And the other half also drinks,
including women and children.
I just drank.
